title: A City of Many Cultures
text:
Our city has people from many countries. Some families speak Portuguese at home, and others speak Japanese or Arabic. People cook different food and celebrate different holidays. This makes our city very interesting.

Cultural diversity helps us learn new things. When we listen to new stories and try new foods, we understand other people better. Schools often hold festivals where students share their traditions. Many students say these days are their favourite days of the year.

questions.text: What do people in the city do differently?
options: Cook different food and celebrate different holidays
Festivals where students share their traditions

questions.text: Why do students probably enjoy the school festivals?
options: They get to share and learn about cultures
They do not have to study

questions.text: What is the author's main opinion?
options: Cultural diversity makes a community richer

vocabulary.definition: a range of different people, cultures or ideas
events where people celebrate together, often with music and food
customs or beliefs passed down from one generation to another
to do something special for a happy day or event

paragraph_translations: Nossa cidade tem pessoas de muitos países. Algumas famílias falam português em casa, e outras falam japonês ou árabe. As pessoas cozinham comidas diferentes e comemoram feriados diferentes. Isso torna nossa cidade muito interessante.

A diversidade cultural nos ajuda a aprender coisas novas. Quando ouvimos histórias novas e experimentamos comidas novas, entendemos melhor outras pessoas. As escolas costumam fazer festivais em que os alunos compartilham suas tradições. Muitos alunos dizem que esses dias são os melhores do ano.
